title: The Scientist Who Implanted a Rat's Head on Another Rat's Body
hook: In 1970, a surgeon grafted a living rat's head onto a second rat's body—and both brains stayed alive for days.
why_this_can_go_viral: Shock value and ethical horror drive immediate clicks, plus the visual imagery is unforgettable.

title: The Lab That Leaked a Nerve Gas Deadlier Than VX

why_this_can_go_viral: Real world bio-horror with stakes that feel personal—viewers fear invisible killers.

title: The Fungus That Hijacks Ant Brains—And Makes Them Explode

why_this_can_go_viral: Gross-out factor plus 'zombie apocalypse in nature' hooks sci-fi and biology fans alike.

title: The Neuroscientist Who 'Cured' PTSD by Erasing a Memory

title: The Parasite That Reprograms Your Brain for Suicide
hook: Toxoplasma gondii infects rats, makes them crave cat urine—but in humans, it's linked to fatal car crashes.
